verdict: REJECT (this model on WebGPU); defect 1 root-caused with validated fix; defect 2 located, root cause UNKNOWN

headline.why_int8_ops_look_exact: ORT Web WebGPU EP partitions MatMulInteger/DynamicQuantizeLinear/ConvInteger back to CPU; proven by an fp32 MatMul rounding DIFFERENTLY on webgpu (3.338e-06) while the same-sized int8 graph is bit-identical
headline.defect_1_minimal_reproducer: single-node graph; fails at 1D/2D/3D, 256..786432 elements, uint8 and int8, zero_point 116 and 0, and all four parameter forms (scalar, rank-1, omitted, per-channel)
headline.defect_1_fix: DequantizeLinear -> Cast->Sub->Mul; native CPU relErr 0.000e+00; WebGPU embedding region 1.486e+09 -> 0.000e+00
headline.defect_2_note: DQL->MatMulInteger is exact on webgpu at 2D, 3D and the model's own [1,1024,768]x[768,768] shapes, so the quantised matmul is not the cause

model_decision.granularity: model x backend x context; says nothing about other models on webgpu, nor about all of wasm
model_decision.product_decision: B - use WASM for this model
